name: QuestMud
english_description: A real, English-language LPMud restored from a 2012 backup of a game whose 'golden age' ran 1996-2000, per its own upstream README: up to 35 concurrent players and over a thousand individual registered accounts at its peak. A full game mudlib set in 'The Isles of Deleria' -- 20 playable races, 9 base guilds plus multiguild combinations, a housing system, mail, and years of individual wizards' own build areas. The first LDMud-lineage lib onboarded into this collection (every other classic lib so far has been MudOS-lineage), which meant several genuinely severe, totally-blocking architectural gaps rather than small dialect differences: master::valid_read() never had a case for the 'load_object'/'include' call_fun values this driver checks on every single object compile and #include, silently denying all of them; master::creator_file()'s 'ordinary object' case returned a bare int where this driver's uid system requires a real string always, destructing almost every non-wizard-owned object right after it compiled; a creator()-based 'reject wizard sandbox clones' guard in the player object's own reset() became permanently true once creator_file() was fixed, self-destructing every newly registered character; this driver's move_object() efun is 1-argument and call_other() never falls back to a same-named efun, so the corpus-wide A->move_object(B) dialect fix silently no-ops whenever A isn't already this_object() (partially fixed via a real move_object() method on the living base class, covering players and monsters; non-living movables are flagged as unfixed follow-up work); efun::-override calls anywhere outside secure/simul_efun.lpc require a master::valid_override() this master never defined; and FluffOS's reset() is scheduled/lazy rather than synchronous-on-load, leaving several daemons' own state unpopulated the first time other code read it. Also ported: closures, wide/multi-value LDMud mappings (no FluffOS equivalent, converted to array-valued mappings), and several missing LDMud-only efuns (cat, tail, strstr, to_string, object_name, unshadow, member, m_delete). Full registration through race/trait/guild selection into the real game world verified live, plus working look/score/quit.
